search_text: published ZDI-16-616 ZDI-CAN-3729 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Network Automation RPCServlet Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-11-30 CVE-2016-8511 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2016-8511 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Network Automation'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Network Automation. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the exposed RPCServlet. By sending a crafted request, the application can be made to deserialize untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process.
